dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Low-profile rounded apex with a broad pixel radius

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse interior angle (approximately 160-170 degrees) at the transition from melon to rostrum

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of distinct dark circular hyper-pigmented spots on the ventral-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights across the dorsal surface and prominent dark mottling on the mid-to-lower flank
